title: Vikram and Betal: The Helpful Stranger
moral: Kindness always comes back to you.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a traveler.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a tired traveler in a forest.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: A stranger gave food and water to the traveler.
scenes.image_prompt: stranger giving food to tired traveler cartoon

scenes.text: The traveler later became successful in life.
scenes.image_prompt: traveler becoming successful in village cartoon

scenes.text: The traveler helped the same stranger later.
scenes.image_prompt: traveler helping stranger with food cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said kindness returns, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: both smiling while helping each other cartoon

story: A traveler was helped by a stranger and later returned the kindness. Vikram said kindness always comes back.
